_provenance: AUTHORED registry of the book models' rendered projections — the small hand-authored truth of what surfaces exist and which projection each belongs to. Each record names a projection, its kind (book|website), the built-output glob(s) it owns, and the builder that emits it. This is the config the DERIVED projection-index scans against; the index (projection-index.json) is generated, this file is written by hand. The `book` vs `website` split is the load-bearing dimension (a cross-cutting concept edit must land on BOTH surfaces); the finer projection id is the sub-grouping.
_regen: This file is AUTHORED (not generated). The DERIVED sibling is book-models/projection-index.json, rebuilt by `python3 book-models/projections_model.py regenerate` (scans the built HTML for every projection's globs). Query with `python3 book-models/projections_model.py where <concept-slug>`.

projections.note: The web book — every chapter, part-opener, appendix, and the assembled index/figures/bibliography pages. Non-recursive: node_modules/ and _print/ under book/ are build scratch, not surfaces.

The Typst print edition. Renders the SAME chapter sources as book-web, so its churn map is a projection of book-web's chapter appearances — the single PDF file is one site, present whenever the concept appears in any book-web page. Gitignored + binary, so the index derives its presence from book-web rather than scanning the PDF; it is exempt from the HTML completeness gate.
The landing — hero, the six Big-Idea bricks, the gateway. A projection of the big-ideas model.
The rich per-idea concept ENTRY pages the landing bricks link to.
The mechanism catalogue — the catalogue-views index plus every role-tree entry (agent/models-bridge/product) and each role README.
Supporting essays / glossary / quickstart / the standalone Big Question page / the browsable book-models reading view.
The standalone theory page — the site-side preview of the book's theory-of-MAGE material (its book projection lives in the Part 6 theory chapters).

The two projected Resource pages — Talks and Writings — from book-models/resources.json. The landing Resources section's four peers are Book (book/) + Curriculum (teach/) + these two; each lists its records with links to the decks/papers under resources/.

The industry-evidence pages — the comparative-analysis view, the industry-case-studies index, and each per-case study page (industry-case-<id>.html). Site-side previews of the book's industry-cases material.
